title: Jumpstart Your Job Search - Teal Webinar -  October 16th
description:
Need help with your resume? Want some job search advice? Tune into Teal's Jumpstart Your Job Search webinar this week to talk all things resumes, ATS, AI and more in your job search

This week's live webinar was hosted by Recruiter and Social Media Manager, Leah Dillon.  In this video, she shares insights and advice about tailoring your resume, highlighting key accomplishments relevant to the job description, and networking tips when messaging recruiters.

Whether it's building your resume, searching for the right job, or marketing yourself for the role you want, we've got you covered with tools like our FREE Chrome Extension, Job Tracker, and Resume Builder. Head over to www.tealhq.com to get started on your AI-powered resume.

These webinars will share similar information and tips every week, so if you're unable to join live, watch past episodes here on YouTube!
